title: Volume 1 Chapter 4: Salvation
content: In the deep darkness, I was attacked by a terrifying monster, surrounded by ice, and felt as if I would die.
Just as those thoughts crossed my mind, a warm hand grasped mine and pulled me to safety.
“Where am I?”
As I regained consciousness, I found Freina, Aria, and Krush by the side of the familiar canopied bed.
“Everyone, what happened?”
“Lady Rana!”
Freina exclaimed in surprise and hugged me tightly.
It was unusual for Freina, who typically didn’t express such fervent emotions. Krush also had tears in her eyes.
Only Aria kept her expression dark, staring at the floor, so I followed her gaze.
There lay Lord Salt, collapsed on the ground.
“Eh?”
I felt a mix of surprise and another sense of unease. He was bleeding from all over his body, lying there motionless.
The sight was abnormal, and normally, just seeing a man would send my heart racing with fear, but strangely, I didn’t feel afraid at all.
Instead, I was worried about him, my chest tightening with concern.
“Why is Lord Salt...?”
“I need to explain. What do you remember?”
Freina asked, her face slightly troubled.
Aria was casting healing magic on Lord Salt with a look of regret.
Like me, she didn’t particularly like men.
Healing magic was a rare attribute, and those who sought health for money had always seen her as a highly sought-after asset, exposing her to various schemes since childhood.
Having seen many ugly adult men, she grew disillusioned and joined the Healers Guild, staying in Corias Territory to observe the Fourth Knight Order.
Since we, Freina, Aria, and I, had grown up together and shared many conversations, I couldn’t shake the feeling of discomfort at her healing Lord Salt.
“Lady Rana, Lord Salt risked his life to save you.”
“Risked his life?”
“Yes!”
Krush nodded in agreement with Freina’s words.
From what I gathered, Lord Salt had not only healed thirty members of the Fourth Knight Order but had also confined the miasma that was spreading in Corias to the forest, purifying everything.
That alone was a heroic act for Corias, but he had also pinpointed that the cursed poison born from the mist’s monsters was the cause of my affliction, galloping here to save me.
He transformed his life force into magic power to eliminate the cursed poison that had taken root within me, completing the healing process.
When I looked at Lord Salt again, I noticed blood oozing from his eyes, ears, and mouth, and his complexion had turned pale.
Aria was administering a blood booster to stabilize him before using her healing magic.
Even so, the chances of him surviving were fifty-fifty, and Aria explained how reckless he had been to save me.
“I can’t deny it.”
Aria sighed as she looked at the fallen Lord Salt, her eyes softening with a gentle smile.
Lord Salt had collapsed after exerting his life force to the limit.
I understood how dangerous my own condition had been.
Though I had just awakened, the dull pain I had felt in my body had vanished, and I felt light all over.
Listening to Freina’s words made me realize that I had lost several days of memory.
Recently, I had felt sluggish, and my condition had been deteriorating.
At first, I thought it was just fatigue as Aria had said, but the symptoms worsened day by day.
Aria had come to examine me, but she couldn’t find the cause.
Even after taking medicine, I found it increasingly difficult to get out of bed.
There was a moment when I thought I was done for.
When I was struck by the fear that this might be my last moment, a warm light enveloped me.
The powerful light that lifted me up brought to mind his face, providing a sense of reassurance.
But at that moment, I was certain I was prepared for death.
“Is this where it ends...?”
That sense of resignation spread within me as I reflected on my life, like watching a slideshow of memories.
Since I was twelve, I had developed well and started to feel the gazes of the men around me.
I married at eighteen but lost my husband during our short marriage.
Returning to my family home, I became the house steward and managed the territory while establishing a women-only knight order due to my fear of men.
I also advocated for the elevation of women’s status, employing women within the territory and distancing myself from men.
Yet, deep down, I had always felt a sense of loneliness.
“Someone, please help me.”
Suddenly, Lord Salt’s face came to mind.
He was the hope I had encountered.
Unlike any man I had met before, his gentlemanly demeanor and the gaze he directed at me were always filled with kindness.
Even as I understood his kindness, I couldn’t shake my fear of men.
While I wished to be saved by him, I couldn’t rid myself of the fear of his touch.
However, he understood all of that, gently touching me, holding my hand, and desperately calling out to heal me.
“It’s okay, I will definitely save you.”
His words echoed in my heart, and clinging to them, I entrusted myself to him, who radiated a pale light.
I didn’t consciously feel the flow of his holy attribute magic entering my body and purifying the cursed poison.
Yet, the pain gradually faded, and my body felt lighter.
The fear of death that had closed in on me felt as if my body had been reborn.
When I opened my eyes, the sight before me was Lord Salt, collapsed and spitting blood.
Tears flowed freely.
Lord Salt had gone this far to save my life.
The fact that he risked his life for me filled my heart with warmth.
As I looked at his face, I thought to myself.
“What do I... think of this person?”
Until now, I had only known fear of men.
But towards Lord Salt, gratitude and trust outweighed my fear.
He had tried to save me at the cost of his life.
His determination and passion moved my heart, not just with gratitude but also with admiration for his kindness and sincerity.
I felt the walls I had built to protect myself begin to crumble little by little.
And I wanted to confirm what that feeling was for myself.
“Lord Salt... I want to talk to you.”
I whispered softly, quietly rising to kneel beside Lord Salt and grasp his hand.
Everyone was surprised by my actions, but seeing him lying there, my heart ached painfully, and I was clearly aware of the new feelings blossoming within me.
“Why... did this happen...?”
My voice trembled. I felt bewildered at the sight of him collapsed.
Of course, I felt gratitude towards him, but more than that, the impact his existence had on me was immense, and I couldn’t sort out my emotions.
“Lady Rana, it was Lord Salt’s experience that allowed him to discern the cursed poison that caused this incident.”
Krush’s words caught my attention, and I listened in a daze.
“He had encountered similar symptoms in his adventurer companions in the past and had the experience of saving them with holy attribute magic.”
“His experience as an adventurer... I see.”
Thanks to Krush’s explanation, I finally understood how he had been able to save me.
Meanwhile, Aria’s expression was bitter.
“I... couldn’t see it... and this man did...”
Aria, realizing her defeat, continued her treatment in silence.
Her pride as a healer must have been wounded by her inability to discern the symptoms caused by the abnormal cursed poison.
“Aria...”
I tried to comfort her, but she didn’t respond to my words.
Just then, Freina asked us a question.
“Lady Rana, have you... overcome your fear of men with Lord Salt?”
I hesitated to answer that question.
I certainly no longer felt fear towards Lord Salt.
On the contrary, I felt deep gratitude towards him.
But whether that meant I had overcome my fear of all men, I still didn’t know.
“...I don’t know. Lord Salt did save me, but... I can’t say whether my fear of all men has been cured.”
At my answer, Aria fixed me with a sharp gaze.
“Then, why not conduct an experiment?”
“An experiment?”
“Yes.
With Lord Salt’s cooperation, we can see if he is a figure you don’t feel fear towards.
By gradually increasing the opportunities for him to look at you and touch you, we can observe how you feel, Lady Rana.”
I couldn’t hide my surprise at that suggestion.
Until now, Aria had helped me avoid men to prevent my fear from worsening. Yet, there was a serious light in her eyes.
She genuinely wanted to help me overcome my fear of men.
“That... still sounds scary.”
“Of course, I’m not saying you have to do it.
But Lord Salt saved you, Lady Rana.
He’s different from the men you’ve known.
Besides, if you can overcome your fear through this, your life will change significantly.”
Freina nodded in agreement with Aria.
Indeed, there was some truth to what they said.
Lord Salt was different from other men; he was a gentleman who risked his life to save me.
Perhaps he could help me...
“Alright... I’ll give it a try.”
I nodded quietly. I decided to take the first step toward overcoming my fear of men with Lord Salt’s cooperation.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ju43I4l.jpeg
“Once Lord Salt has recovered, I will ask him to help me overcome my fear of men.”
The three of them watched my determination, smiling gently in agreement.
“Let’s do our best.”
That single phrase sparked a new resolve within me.
With Lord Salt’s help, I was about to confront the trauma of my past.
I wanted to believe that the time spent with him would gradually unravel the fear that had been within me.
After a while, Lord Salt awoke, showing signs of recovery.
“Once again, thank you so much for saving the Fourth Knight Order from the cursed poison.”
“Oh, it’s nothing. That’s my job now.”
“And thank you for noticing my changes in health and risking your life to save me, even when your magic power was depleted.”
“Ah, that was just luck, but I’m glad I could save you, Lady Rana.”
He seemed embarrassed, unused to receiving thanks, and his bashful demeanor was endearing.
Everything about him, which I had previously regarded with caution, now appeared wonderful.
From then on, I resolved to take the next step to have Lord Salt help me overcome my fear of men.
I began to think of how to approach this.
Doing something with a man usually sent shivers down my spine just at the thought.
But knowing Lord Salt’s kindness, I felt I could ask him for help.
“Lord Salt, I have a small request.”
“Yes? If it’s something I can do, please tell me!”
I struggled to suppress the tremor in my voice as I began to speak.
He seemed to sense something and looked at me with a cautious expression.
“Well... I want to overcome my fear of men. Would you help me with that?”
At my request, Lord Salt’s eyes widened in surprise.
It was no wonder; I couldn’t believe I was asking for something like this myself.
But this was a necessary step for me.
I couldn’t move forward without overcoming this.
“Um, are you sure? Of course, if it’s something I can help with, I’d like to.”
“Thank you.”
“However, how exactly should we go about it?”
I was pleased that he was gently asking me even at this moment.
“Well, I want you to see my body!”
“Huh?”
I felt embarrassed, heat rising to my face.
However, I was afraid of men’s gazes.
Therefore, I thought that by allowing Lord Salt to see my body, I could get used to being looked at by men.
“Of course, I’m not saying you have to do it. But... if you could cooperate somehow...”
I could feel the tremor in my voice. Showing my body to a man had always been a source of fear for me. But Lord Salt...
After a moment of silence, Lord Salt took a deep breath and looked straight at me.
“Understood, Lady Rana. I will never force you to do anything. I respect your will.”
His words sank deep into my heart.
I felt a gentle yet strong determination in his voice. Hearing that gave me a bit of courage.
“...Thank you, Lord Salt.”
I slowly began to roll up the sleeves of my dress.
His gaze fell on my exposed arms. Normally, just this would make me tremble, but today felt a little different.
Though tension and fear should have coursed through my body, it didn’t feel as intense this time.
Rather, I felt a warmth in my chest at the thought that he saw me as a woman.
“...You have very beautiful arms. Are you alright, Lady Rana?”
I exhaled deeply and smiled at him, filled with gratitude.
“It’s a bit embarrassing, but I’m okay.”
Thus, little by little, I began to take steps toward overcoming my fear, with his help.
